name: crewforge5
description: CrewForge5 — agent crews as a managed resource: /crewforge5:init, the /crewforge5:plan, design, build and review stages, and /crewforge5:execute.

plugins.name: crewforge5
plugins.description: Six commands over one repo: /crewforge5:init audits and slims your Claude config, /crewforge5:plan, /crewforge5:design and /crewforge5:build turn a goal into human-accepted intent, spec and test-first plan, /crewforge5:review checks and reviews the implementation, and /crewforge5:execute drives a reviewed plan to a merged commit with a generated agent crew and its quality gates.

metadata.description: Marketplace for the crewforge5 plugin; add with `claude plugin marketplace add linus-McM/crewforge5`.
